description: Human-curated layer over the generated differences in protobuf-audit-inventory.json. The 24 legacy discrepancy texts are not stored here: they are copied verbatim from wire-conformance-matrix.json, whose per-entry sha256 is pinned in legacy_pins. 'covers' lists generated difference IDs; individual per-difference triage judgement lives in protobuf-audit-triage.json (zero broad 'accepted' buckets).

claims.text: The pinned AASDK MediaMessageId names value 32778 (0x800A) MEDIA_MESSAGE_UPDATE_UI_CONFIG_REPLY.
The OAA message-id enum has 0x8009 UPDATE_UI_CONFIG_REQUEST and no 0x800A entry.
AASDK carries the 0x8009 and 0x800A payloads in two messages (UpdateUiConfigRequest, UpdateUiConfigReply); OAA defines one UpdateUiConfigRequest.
0x8009/0x800A are the two directions of one request and 'no reply is implied'; the real reply is 0x8012 (OAA, 'gold' handler evidence).

current_behavior.text: No UI-config message (0x8009/0x800A/0x8011/0x8012) is referenced anywhere in src/ or include/.

findings.rationale: Mechanical difference confirmed; the 'reply vs request' reading of 0x800A rests on OAA handler comments that are not independently verified here.
findings.receiver_impact: The receiver neither consumes 0x8009 nor emits 0x800A; the phone-side semantics of 0x800A are an OAA claim.

claims.text: The pinned AASDK MediaMessageId ends at 32779 (0x800B) and has no 0x8012.
OAA defines UpdateHuUiConfigResponse (ThemingTokensStatus ERROR=0, ACCEPTED=1, REJECTED=2) for id 0x8012.
OAA's own confidence for the 0x8012 message is 'unverified'.
Without 0x8012 the theming-token exchange (0x8011 -> 0x8012) cannot be answered.

current_behavior.text: No reference to 0x8011/0x8012 or UpdateHuUiConfigResponse in src/ or include/.

findings.rationale: AASDK has no 0x8011/0x8012 ids; OAA marks the 0x8012 message itself 'confidence: unverified'.
findings.receiver_impact: No 0x8011/0x8012 exchange exists in the receiver; whether a phone requires it is unverified.

claims.text: AASDK UiConfig has fields 1-4; OAA AdditionalVideoConfig has fields 1-8.
Tags 1-4 are wire-compatible between the two (same numbers, varint/len types); 5-8 are extensions.
Fields 5-8 are GAL 4.3+ features (hidden_ui_elements, resize_actions, margin_configs, blended_ui_config).

current_behavior.text: UnknownFields.hpp keeps ExtensionPolicy::reject as the boundary default.

findings.rationale: Deferred until the UI-config exchange (D1/D2) is implemented; extension tolerance policy decision belongs with it.
findings.receiver_impact: AdditionalVideoConfig fields 5-8 are unrepresentable in the pinned schema; no UI-config consumer exists, so nothing reads them today.

claims.text: AASDK Config.Status is WAIT=1/READY=2; OAA AVChannelSetupStatus is NONE=0/FAIL=1/OK=2.
The receiver emits READY (2) only.

current_behavior.text: encode_av_sink_ready() sets Config::STATUS_READY (2); status 1 is never emitted.

findings.rationale: Conflict is mechanical (WAIT=1 vs FAIL=1); no gap while only 2 is emitted. Phone evidence is needed to classify value 1.
findings.receiver_impact: Receiver emits status 2 only (READY/OK agree); how a phone treats value 1 is unverified.

findings.rationale: Mechanical enum difference plus verified fail-closed handling. Whether phones actually send 3/4 is OAA's claim.
findings.receiver_impact: A phone sending VideoFocusReason 3 or 4 would have the whole 0x8007 request rejected as malformed.

findings.rationale: Field 1 exists only in AASDK (mechanical); the receiver never routes on it.
findings.receiver_impact: None: field 1 is accepted and ignored; routing uses mode (field 2).

The 17.3 endpoint receives no payload on 0x800B.

findings.receiver_impact: The receiver never sends 0x800B; whether a phone parses a body is unverified.

findings.receiver_impact: No consumer: the receiver does not read the request's fields.

findings.rationale: Field-16 presence only in AASDK is mechanical; OAA's retraction of the field-16 mapping is an upstream claim.
findings.receiver_impact: None today: the encoder never sets field 16. OAA claims phones ignore or reject it.

findings.receiver_impact: A ChannelOpenResponse carrying -26/-27 is rejected as malformed; those values belong to car control, which is intentionally unsupported (D32).
